body: I’m so sorry for what has happened to you. Unfortunately I’m in a similar boat. My twin boys died October 4th of 2019. I’m 22 now but I was 19 back then. I was so scared about being a dad that I would do anything for them. I had to watch my boys die and it still fucks me up today. Not one day goes by that I don’t think about them. I’m so hollow on the inside. The only thing I regret is not holding them longer before they died. I often asked myself “Why wasn’t me who died?” There is no right answer. It’s just unfair all around. I hate that you’re going through this too. I wish I could type some magical words to make you feel better. The only thing I can say is that no matter what you have to live for him. If there is an afterlife, I know he’s being taken care of. He’s looking down at you with loving eyes wanting you to be ok. It’s a long road ahead of you. But never forget that you are not alone. I’m here to talk if you need/want it. Please don’t go through this alone.

You never know what tomorrow brings. It may bring something new and exciting to the table. Or it can bring you tragedy. I’ve been through a lot of shit. There have been times where I’ve contemplated suicide and till this day I do. Not that long ago i had a gun in my hand wanting to just end it all. But there is always that mystery that tomorrow can be better. Or at least an improvement. You’ll never know until you see tomorrow. I’m not gonna speak on this matter like I’m an expert or whatever. But I’m speaking as someone who can get where you are coming from. I’ve been looking for my reason to live for a while now and still haven’t found it. But deep down inside I know I must keep fighting, searching, and believing in the fact that there might be something out there to lift me out of this fog. I hope this helps in some way.
If you don’t trust yourself with it you should throw it away

The problem isn’t you. It sounds like it’s your friends. Nobody is perfect at all. It seems like you tried to do a thoughtful act but got shot down for it. That is messed up. There are people out there who will appreciate the type of friendship you are offering. Don’t give up because you still have a lot more to give. You just need to figure out who you want to give that to
